Method of Attack: Backdoor trojan malware developed via hired local programmer
Spear-phishing emails with file attachments that covertly install malware
Data exfiltration of passwords, sensitive documents, keystroke information
Uploading stolen data to online servers or sending via SMTP email
Impacted Systems: Systems of high-ranking Italian officials including former prime ministers Matteo Renzi and Mario Monti
Head of the European Central Bank Mario Draghi
Members of several Italian ministries (Finance, Economy, Internal Affairs, Foreign Affairs, and others)
Attack Vector: Spear-phishing emails with malicious file attachments
Indicators of Compromise: Collected data including 87GB of keystroke info, 18,327 usernames, 1,793 passwords
